notes.title: Happy Game got physical!
notes.content:
Have you ever wished to bring a little piece of Happy Game in your home...? Well, now is the time. ːhgveryhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/3e873699e6812c48fbd3c521b393fc51c6043815.jpg

The Xzone Edition, made in collaboration with Czech company Xzone is now for sale in our shop, and since all of these include a screen-printed card signed by the game's creator Jaromír Plachý, there's only a few hundred of these available. Do not hesitate if you need this in your collection! Might as well be a nice gift for, uh... basically anyone, right?

Here's all that is included:
- Happy Game Steam key (Windows, Mac)
- 50-page mini artbook
- Screen-printed card signed by Jaromír Plachý
- Slip-cover packaging
- Exclusive sticker set
- Temporary tattoo set
- Downloadable original soundtrack by DVA
